title: Merge two sorted linked lists
summary: Two sorted trains meet at a junction; send through the smaller front carriage each time to make one sorted train.
goal: Join two sorted trains into one sorted train

examples.label: Two short trains
examples.explanation: Carriages leave in order, taking the smaller front carriage each time.

examples.label: One empty train
examples.explanation: The other train passes through unchanged.

ladder.name: Join, then sort
ladder.idea: Put every carriage into one list and sort it.

ladder.name: Zip with two pointers
ladder.idea: Watch the front carriage of each train and link whichever is smaller next, until one train runs out; then attach the rest of the other.
ladder.insight: Both trains are already sorted, so the next carriage overall is always one of the two front carriages. Sorting again throws that order away.

transfer.problem: Two shops each keep a list of orders sorted by time. Produce one list of all orders sorted by time.
transfer.explanation: Two already-sorted lists: compare the fronts and take the earlier order each time.

selfCheck: Takes the smaller front value each time, the first train's on a tie.
Attaches the leftover train when one runs out.
Handles one or both trains being empty.
Relinks existing nodes instead of copying values.
